_doc: kumori_free_image_generations registry. STRICT criteria: zero signup, zero credit card, zero monthly bill. Services that require even a free account are excluded. Sources for every limit are cited in README.md. Last verified live: 2026-04-27.

_excluded._why_listed: documenting WHY popular options didn't make the cut so we don't keep researching them
_excluded.huggingface_inference: free signup required; small monthly credit then paid
_excluded.together_ai: free signup required (no card but account needed)
_excluded.replicate: pay-per-call after one-time credit; not free
_excluded.deepai: free tier requires paid signup; 'quickstart' demo key returns 401
_excluded.nvidia_nim: 5K LIFETIME credits — finite, depletes; flagged 'conservation' in kumori_free_llm
_excluded.google_imagen: no free API tier (consumer ChatGPT/Gemini have free UI but not API)
_excluded.perchance: keyless web UI but Cloudflare Turnstile blocks programmatic access; no documented API
_excluded.huggingface_spaces: Gradio public API often gated; ZeroGPU Spaces require PRO account

pollinations.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 14_0) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
pollinations.notes: Anonymous tier: 1 req/15s/IP. Concurrent=1. Default urllib UA returns 403. Source: github.com/pollinations/pollinations APIDOCS.md.

cloudflare_flux.daily_limit_reason: 10K neurons/day total free pool. flux at 4 steps + 512x512 ~= 492 neurons/img -> ~20 imgs/day. Going over does NOT bill us automatically — Cloudflare requires Workers Paid plan to be enabled separately, which we have NOT enabled.
cloudflare_flux.notes: Fastest free option (~1.6s). Existing secret, no new signup. Bills $0/mo until we explicitly enable Workers Paid plan.

cloudflare_dreamshaper.notes: Returns binary image directly (not base64). Shares 10K-neuron pool with cloudflare_flux.

stable_horde.notes: Truly unlimited free. Anonymous = lowest priority (-50 kudos). Live status 2026-04-27: 14 workers, 17-30s typical. NEVER refuses, just slow. Use as last-resort fallback.
